mission_hooks: Experimental calibration and corridor stability trials
Competing engineering, navigation, science and command assessments
Emergency interruption, incident investigation and rescue if supported by causal campaign state
Safety certification, development setbacks, authorization and controlled deployment
Follow-on Valhalla adaptation and verification after 2387 if required
continuity_rules: Experimental activity after the campaign start is a possibility, never a guaranteed scripted event.
Failure/success, modifications, incidents, ship condition and permissions persist in CoreRPG.
Research progress is not granted by the calendar alone.
Odyssey class availability in 2383 does not imply that USS Enterprise-F is a playable or present individual ship.
Valhalla class commissioning target 2387 does not imply that quantum slipstream is ready on that date.
